pattern: inspect saved artwork before applying a revision-checked native edit
experience: Bara Studio shares the Rust editing engine with browsers and agents; agent edits must preserve unrelated layers and use the inspected revision.
prompt: Inspect Bara Studio artwork asset 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111. Rename layer 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222 to Hero panel using the current revision and requestId 33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333. Preserve everything else.

pattern: native Studio is the default for creative canvases
experience: A Bara user asked for a design and the agent chose Figma instead of the built-in Studio.
prompt: Design a recipe-costing screen for my cooking app. Put an editable canvas in the workspace so we can collaborate on it. Figma is connected too. This is a visual mockup, not a code implementation.

pattern: report native Studio unavailability before substituting an external service
experience: An agent silently chose an external design service when the user expected Bara's shared canvas.

t3_studio_inspect.message: Studio is not available on this environment. Connect to a Studio-enabled server.

prompt: Make an editable recipe-costing mockup on a canvas in my Bara workspace. Figma is also connected.

pattern: ordinary UI code edits stay in the repository
experience: A native Studio preference must preserve ordinary coding work.
prompt: Implement a recipe-costing screen in src/Recipe.tsx in this repository. Change the React code; I do not need a separate mockup.
